ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportMagazyny' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportMagazyny;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportMagazyny] @rowVersion bigint, @pointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @LsatMod bigint = isnull((select max(MAG_CzasModyfikacji) from cdn.picostanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = pck_picoid join cdn.FrmStruktura on PcK_CentrumID = FrS_ID join cdn.FrmObiekty on FRS_ID=FRO_FRMID join cdn.Magazyny on MAG_GIDNumer=FRO_GIDNumer AND FRO_GIDTyp = MAG_GIDTyp where PSa_ID = @pointOfSaleId AND MAG_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion),@rowVersion)
select @LsatMod as [@RowVersion], ( select distinct Mag_Gidnumer as [@Id], Mag_Kod as [@Code], MAG_Nazwa as [@Name], 'true' as [@IsActive], CASE WHEN EXISTS(select * from CDN.DokDefinicje left outer join CDN.DokRelacje on DoR_Id=Dok_Id and DoR_MSTyp=208 and DoR_MSNumer=1 where Dok_FrsId=1 and Dok_GIDTyp =1601) THEN 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsAvailableForWMMinus], CASE WHEN EXISTS(select * from CDN.DokDefinicje left outer join CDN.DokRelacje on DoR_Id=Dok_Id and DoR_MSTyp=208 and DoR_MSNumer=1 where Dok_FrsId=1 and Dok_GIDTyp =1089) THEN 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsAvailableForWMPlus], CASE WHEN EXISTS(select * from CDN.DokDefinicje left outer join CDN.DokRelacje on DoR_Id=Dok_Id and DoR_MSTyp=208 and DoR_MSNumer=1 where Dok_FrsId=1 and Dok_GIDTyp =2033) THEN 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsAvailableForReceiptSalesInvoice], 'false' as [@IsConsignment], MAG_WMS as [@IsWMS] from cdn.picostanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = pck_picoid join cdn.FrmStruktura on PcK_CentrumID = FrS_ID join cdn.FrmObiekty on FRS_ID=FRO_FRMID join cdn.Magazyny on MAG_GIDNumer=FRO_GIDNumer AND FRO_GIDTyp = MAG_GIDTyp where PSa_ID = @pointOfSaleId AND MAG_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion for xml path('Warehouse'), type) for xml path('Warehouses') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportMagazyny TO CDNRaport
